title: WoW: Forever Wraps the Biggest Beta in Franchise History
summary: World of Warcraft: Forever has just finished the largest beta test in the history of the game, according to Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella. A beta test lets players try a game before it is fully ready. Before, players had to sign up and hope Blizzard picked them. This time, Blizzard also gave beta access to players who bought the War Within and Midnight expansions. An unofficial tool, ClassicPlus.io, suggests over one million characters were created during the beta. Developer Josh Greenfield called the turnout the craziest numbers he had seen in 17 years at Blizzard and almost 8 years working on classic games. In a post on September 18, 2026, he said he was so excited he could hardly sleep. The game is a sort of alternate universe version of World of Warcraft, set in the world of the original game but with different twists in its story and content. The beta ran from September 17 through October 23. The full game launches on November 4 for anyone with an existing World of Warcraft subscription.
why_it_matters: If you play games, it shows why test versions exist: players get to try new worlds early and help find problems before everyone plays.
